follow-up time: 20 years (1990-2010 for the first cohort and 2010-2020 for the second cohort)
cohort: 107 pregnancies in SLE patients followed at the Department of Rheumatology, Aarhus University Hospital, Denmark (41 women in the 2010-2020 cohort and an unspecified number in the 1990-2010 cohort)
finding: Although a high risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes (APO) remained, significant improvements were observed in the frequency of some APOs in the recent 2010-2020 cohort compared with the previous cohort followed from 1990 to 2010.
mod_finding: The 2010-2020 cohort experienced a numerical reduction in emergent caesarean sections (6.1% vs. 15.5%) compared to the 1990-2010 cohort, although this did not reach statistical significance (p = .07).
birth_weight: Average birth weight was higher in the 2010-2020 cohort (3045 g) compared to the 1990-2010 cohort (2870 g).
